title: Chief Marketing Officer
sourceText: Chief Marketing Officer Fusion Business Solutions Udaipur Experience: 10-20 Yrs Salary: Not disclosed Skills: Abm, Demand Generation, Marketing Automation, CRM Tool, SEO, Content Strategy, Analytics, AI Tools, Marketing Tools, Account Based Marketing, Marketing Planning, Marketing Budget, Marketing Strategies Role & responsibilities The role is organized around five outcome areas: 1. Brand Positioning & Market Differentiation Own the narrative. Define and continuously sharpen FBSPLs value proposition, positioning, and messaging to clearly differentiate the firm from traditional BPO providers in a competitive market. Codify the story. Translate FBSPLs single-vendor, consulting-led, AI-enabled model into a compelling, defensible market story across service lines and buyer personas. Ensure consistency. Establish and govern messaging architecture, brand guidelines, and tone of voice, ensuring consistent positioning across every channel and client-facing asset. 2. Image Creation & Thought Leadership Elevate the brand. Build FBSPLs reputation as an intelligence-led transformation authority through thought leadership, PR, executive visibility, podcasts, webinars, and industry events. Build authority. Develop and amplify executive and founder-led thought-leadership platforms to strengthen credibility with relevant industry audience. Shape perception. Own the corporate website, LinkedIn presence, and content engine case studies, insight reports, and solution narratives that build trust and shape perception. 3. Client Acquisition Enablement Enable the sale. Partner closely with sales and business development to build a scalable go-to-market motion that generates qualified pipeline and accelerates revenue in a consultative, long-cycle selling environment. Prove the value. Convert FBSPLs operational strengths AMS optimization, cost efficiency, scalability, quality and SLA performance into persuasive, client-facing value propositions. Arm the team. Develop world-class sales presentations, pitch decks, capability decks, RFP responses, and vertical-specific collateral tailored to target accounts in the USA and Canada. Drive demand. Build, optimize, and scale inbound and outbound demand-generation programs using ABM, marketing automation, CRM, SEO, content, and AI-enabled martech. 4. Market Assessment & Intelligence Read the market. Analyze market trends, competitors, target verticals, and customer insights to guide positioning and go-to-market decisions. Spot the opportunity. Identify priority industries, buyer personas, and growth opportunities including new-market and service-line expansion. Inform strategy. Produce market studies, competitive intelligence, and insight reports that inform leadership strategy and sharpen FBSPL’s differentiation. 5. Team Building & Marketing Leadership Own the strategy. Set and lead FBSPL’s overall marketing strategy, aligning brand, demand, and content to the firm’s transformation from execution-led outsourcing to intelligence-led consulting. Build the team. Build the marketing function from the ground up – recruit, structure, and shape a team aligned to FBSPL’s growth ambitions. Develop your people. Develop and nurture talent through coaching, mentoring, and clear career pathways, fostering a collaborative, high-performance culture. Lead the team. Lead and direct the team day to day, set clear directives, and manage external agencies and partners to extend the team’s capacity. Own the numbers. Own the marketing budget and report to leadership on pipeline, ROI, brand health, and business impact. Drive alignment. Align marketing tightly with sales, operations, and delivery to ensure every activity supports commercial outcomes. What Success Looks Like Outcome Area & Indicative Measures 1.Brand & Positioning Share of voice, brand awareness, message consistency, inbound brand-led enquiries 2.Demand Generation Qualified pipeline, MQLs/SQLs, cost per acquisition, funnel conversion rates 3.Sales Enablement Win rate, sales-cycle length, deck/collateral adoption, proposal quality 4.Market Intelligence Coverage of priority verticals, quality of insight informing GTM decisions 5.Commercial Impact Marketing-sourced revenue, ROI, contribution to new-market expansion Preferred candidate profile : Depth: 10+ years of progressive B2B marketing experience, with at least 5 years in a leadership role. Sales partnership: Proven success partnering with sales in consultative, long-cycle, multi-stakeholder selling environments. Domain: Experience marketing complex services or solutions that require customer education and differentiation; outsourcing, BPO, insurance, or professional-services exposure strongly preferred. Strategy: Track record developing positioning, messaging, and content strategies, and building demand-generation engines. Markets: Experience marketing to USA and Canada markets is a strong advantage. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or related field; MBA preferred. Skills & Competencies Technical: ABM, demand generation, marketing automation, CRM (e.g. HubSpot/Salesforce), SEO, content strategy, analytics, and AI-enabled marketing tools. Strategic: Strategic thinking, commercial acumen, and the ability to link marketing activity to revenue and growth. Leadership: Strong leadership, cross-functional influence, and executive communication – including the ability to work across teams without direct line authority. Execution: Hands-on, entrepreneurial style balancing strategic planning with tactical execution. Why This Role This is a rare opportunity to build and lead a modern marketing function for an organization that treats marketing as a critical driver of growth. You will help define how FBSPL is seen in the market at a pivotal moment in its transformation from execution-led outsourcing to intelligence-led consulting. Real ownership. A seat at the leadership table, with direct influence over company strategy and go-to-market direction. Build something. The chance to build the marketing function and team from the ground up and shape how it grows. Visible impact. High visibility across the organization and the opportunity to leave a lasting mark on a growing global business.
